summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for Cadence v1.6.0 introducing:
1. Feature #23: Disable Embedded Video Previews (disableVideoPreviews: true by default, 5th popup toggle, Playback & Feed Controls card on options page, blocking thumbnail previews on Home/Search/Sidebar while preserving /@channel trailers).
2. Feature #24: Real-Time Per-Video & Global Lifetime Time Saved tracking (banked + projected saved time, continuous atomic persistence, End-of-Video banner savings readout, popup footer badge, and options page stat card with inline 'Forget Time Saved' reset flow and JSON backup/restore).
3. Feature #26: Paginate, Sort, and Filter Saved Channel Rules on the Options page (10/25/50/All pagination, instant search by channel name/handle, preset category filter controls, and multi-mode sorting).
4. Full runtime settingsSchemaVersion migration from 4 to 5 across background service worker, storage helpers, and companion web workspace while keeping CWS Studio assets locked at v1.5.1.
